title: Green Valley Residences
description:
Green Valley Residences – Complete BIM Design & Coordination

Project Type: Multi-Family Residential Development

Project Description

NOPEX successfully delivered complete Architectural, Structural, and MEP BIM Design services for the Green Valley Residences project, a modern multi-family residential development. Our team managed the project from concept design through construction documentation, ensuring seamless coordination between all building disciplines.

The scope included architectural planning, floor plans, elevations, façade design, structural analysis and detailing, HVAC design, plumbing systems, electrical layouts, fire protection systems, and multidisciplinary BIM coordination. Using advanced BIM workflows, we developed coordinated 3D models to identify and resolve clashes before construction, improve constructability, and enhance project efficiency.

Our team also prepared construction drawings, shop drawings, quantity take-offs (BOQ), and coordinated BIM models to support the construction process and facilitate collaboration among architects, engineers, contractors, and project stakeholders.

The BIM models were developed to LOD 350–400, with LOD 500 As-Built Models prepared for facility management and future maintenance.

title: Modern Luxury Single-Family Villa
description:

Project Description

NOPEX successfully delivered a complete Architectural, Structural, and MEP BIM Design package for a modern luxury single-family villa. Our scope included architectural planning, space programming, floor plans, elevations, sections, façade development, structural design, HVAC systems, plumbing, electrical layouts, fire protection coordination, and detailed 3D BIM modeling.
